text:
elaine: Quick sync — need to lock launch criteria for the new "isolation lanes" feature before tomorrow's roadmap review. Sales/customer asks condensed: per-tenant isolation, cross-region failover options, data residency controls, and clear pricing deltas. Draft proposal below; feedback by EOD please.

matt: +1, share the draft pls.

elaine: Draft (high level):
```
- Lanes: shared, soft-isolate, hard-isolate
- Launch criteria:
  - latency SLO: p95 < 200ms for shared/soft; p95 < 300ms for hard
  - error rate delta < 0.5% vs baseline during canary
  - migration path + opt-in toggle per-tenant
  - observability: per-tenant token-level cost + latency breakdown
  - security: KMS integration + audit log forwarding for hard lane
  - rollout: canary (1%) -> 10% -> 100% with automated rollback triggers
- Routing policy flags: region_affinity, failover_mode (none|readonly|full), isolation_level
```

tara: "soft-isolate" = cache partitioning only? need clarity on cost/behavior.

matt: Soft = logical isolation: prefix-based KV cache partitioning, quota segregation, routing headers. Hard = dedicated GPU pool + network isolation + KMS per-tenant. Pricing needs explicit delta.

kai: FYI customer request from big financial: must have dedicated hardware + HSM binding + audit trails. They also want cross-region failover but cannot have active-active reads outside region for residency reasons.

elaine: Good call. Add requirement: failover must honor residency unless tenant opts into cross-region DR (explicit agreement). Update policy: failover_mode: none|readonly|full with residency constraints.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary for "soft-isolate" lane planned 1768002000 -> 1768005600.

tara: For launch criteria we also need: documented migration playbook, opt-in flag in console, success metrics (latency regression < 10%, error delta < 0.5%), and runbook for rollback.

matt: Add automated rollback: fallback to compatible model variant + route to shared pool if GPU reservation exhaustion detected. Also quota enforcement so noisy tenant doesn't starve lane.

elaine: Agree. Also require cost visibility: console must show per-tenant estimated monthly delta before enabling hard lane.

kai: Can we surface an "audit-ready" checklist for enterprise sales: KMS bound keys, HSM requirement (if requested), SIEM forwarding, and compliance doc pack.

matt: I'll draft an infra RFC with schema and implementation plan. Quick schema sketch: 
```
routing_policy:
  isolation_level: hard
  region_affinity: ["us-west-2"]
  failover_mode: readonly
  quota_reservation: 100rps
```

tara: Timeline suggestion from product: MVP soft-isolate in ~8 weeks, soft+hard launch + private deployment options in 16–20 weeks depending on infra hiring and HSM partner.

elaine: Sounds reasonable. Action items: matt to open RFC + perf tests, tara to own migration docs and pricing deltas, kai to collect customers with HSM/audit needs, me to update roadmap slide + launch checklist. Anyone object?

matt: No objections. I'll start the RFC and add perf targets.

kai: I'll DM the customer list and specifics later today.

elaine: Locking decision-in-principle here. Will post RFC link and the updated slide deck in this thread when ready. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
